About this edition: All 13 profiles were cut to transparent PNGs from Lucian's uploaded photos (PNG masters kept in the project; the site loads optimized renditions of the same cutouts). Titles are each player's most well-known nickname, restyled per player: JT in Celtics green, Cade in Detroit Tigers blackletter, The Joker in the yellow hand-scrawled style of the 2019 film, The Greek Freak in refined Greek letters mixed into the English, Wemby in neon Area 51 stencil, Book in a Phoenix orange-to-purple lowrider gradient, Chef Curry in Warriors yellow, The Klaw in solid Jurassic-style stone type, The Truth in Knicks orange, The Brow in collegiate gold, Dame Time italic in red on black, JB in a scientist's technical type, and Melo in LaFrance gothic. Jaylen Brown (Sixers No. 7) and LaMelo Ball (Timberwolves jersey) identified by Lucian. Cade Cunningham read from his No. 2 piston pendant and Detroit Fila fit. No ratings are shown in this edition — the showcase is the style.
